steps.text: Talk to an Examiner in the Exam Centre south east of Varrock.
Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.

Search the bushes north of the Exam Centre for a teddy.
Pick up the tray in the south east of the dig site.
Talk to the Panning Guide nearby.
Pan in the river for a special cup.
Search the panning tray.
Pickpocket workmen until you get an animal skull and a specimen brush.
Talk to the female student in the north west of the Digsite twice.
Talk to the student in an orange shirt in the north east of the Digsite twice.
Talk to the student in a green shirt in the south of the Digsite twice.

choices: I am ready for the last exam...
Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.

steps.text: Search the cupboard on the south wall of the west room of the Exam Centre for a specimen jar.
Pickpocket workmen until you get a specimen brush.
Dig in the north east dig spot in the Digsite until you get a talisman.
Talk to the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
Use the invitation on any workman.
choices: I lost the letter you gave me.

steps.text: Use a rope on the west winch.
Climb down the west winch.
Pick up some arcenia root.
Search the bricks to the south.
Climb back to the surface.
Use a rope on the north east winch.
Climb down the north east winch.
Talk to Doug Deeping.
choices: How could I move a large pile of rocks?

steps.text: Leave Doug's cave.
Use the key on the chest in the tent in the south of the Digsite.
Search the chest.
Use a trowel on the barrel west of the chest's tent.
Use a vial on the barrel west of the chest's tent.
Use the powder on the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
(DO NOT LEFT CLICK) Right-click use the liquid on the Archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.
Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together.
Grind charcoal with a pestle and mortar.
Add the ground charcoal to the vial.
Add arcenia root to the vial.

Climb down the rope on the west winch.

Use a tinderbox on the bricks to the south.
Take the stone tablet in the south room.
